title: Set 238

sentences.ko: 어제 택배가 하루 종일 배송 중으로 떠 있어서 집에서 기다렸거든. 근데 밤 9시에 갑자기 배송 시도로 바뀌는 거야. 아무도 문 안 두드렸어! 나 그동안 계속 문 바로 앞에 앉아 있었는데.
sentences.text: My package said out for delivery all day yesterday, so I stayed home and waited, and then at nine it just switched to delivery attempted. Nobody even knocked! I was sitting right by the door the whole time.

alts.text: Tracking had it out for delivery all day, so I stayed in. Then at nine it flips to delivery attempted. No knock, nothing! I was right by the door.

My package was marked as out for delivery all day yesterday, so I remained at home to wait for it, and then at nine o'clock the status simply changed to delivery attempted. No one knocked at all! I was sitting right beside the door the entire time.

sentences.note: **out for delivery** 는 배송 조회에서 쓰는 배송 출발, 배송 중이라는 말이에요. 캐주얼에 나오는 **flips to** 는 상태가 휙 바뀐다는 느낌으로 switched to 대신 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 도예를 진짜 제대로 배워 보고 싶어서 재료를 이것저것 다 샀는데, 수업은 딱 세 번 가고 말았어. 이제는 너무 오래돼서 다시 나가기가 좀 민망해. 그래서 다 그냥 옷장에 처박혀 있어.
sentences.text: I bought all this stuff because I really wanted to get into pottery, but I only made it to three classes, and now it's been so long that I'd feel weird showing up again. So it's all just sitting in my closet.

alts.text: Got all this pottery stuff since I really wanted to get into it, but I only went to three classes. It's been so long now it'd be weird to show back up, so it's all just sitting in my closet.

I purchased all of these supplies because I genuinely wanted to take up pottery, but I attended only three classes, and it has now been so long that I would feel uncomfortable returning. As a result, everything is simply sitting in my closet.

sentences.note: **get into** 는 어떤 취미에 빠져들다, 제대로 시작하다라는 뜻이에요. **just sitting in my closet** 은 쓰지도 않고 옷장에 그냥 놓여 있다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 식기세척기 고치는 법을 찾아보려던 거였는데, 어쩌다 보니 어떤 아저씨가 낡은 배 고치는 영상을 두 시간이나 보고 있더라. 덕분에 배에 대해서는 쓸데없이 많이 알게 됐는데, 식기세척기는 아직도 고장 나 있어.
sentences.text: I was supposed to be looking up how to fix the dishwasher, but somehow I ended up watching some guy fix up an old boat for two hours. So now I know way too much about boats, and the dishwasher's still broken.

alts.text: Went to look up how to fix the dishwasher and somehow ended up watching a guy redo an old boat for two hours. Now I know way too much about boats, and the dishwasher's still busted.

I was meant to be researching how to repair the dishwasher, but somehow I spent two hours watching a man restore an old boat. Consequently, I now know far too much about boats, and the dishwasher is still not working.

sentences.note: **ended up** ~ing 는 원래 계획과 달리 결국 ~하게 됐다는 뜻이에요. 캐주얼의 **busted** 는 broken 을 편하게 말한 고장 났다입니다.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

sentences.ko: 윗집 사람이 거의 이틀에 한 번꼴로 새벽 2시에 가구를 옮겨. 한 번은 말하려고 올라갔는데 아무도 안 나오더라. 그래서 지금은 쪽지를 붙여야 할지 아니면 바로 집주인한테 말해야 할지 모르겠어.
sentences.text: Somebody upstairs moves furniture around at two in the morning, like every other night. I went up to say something once, but nobody answered, so now I don't know if I should leave a note or just go straight to the landlord.

alts.text: Upstairs is dragging furniture around at like 2 a.m., every other night. Went up once, nobody came to the door, so I dunno, leave a note or just go straight to the landlord?

Someone in the unit above moves furniture around at two o'clock in the morning, roughly every other night. I went upstairs once to mention it, but no one answered, so I am now unsure whether I should leave a note or go directly to the landlord.

sentences.note: **every other night** 는 이틀에 한 번이라는 뜻이에요. **go straight to the landlord** 는 중간 단계 없이 바로 집주인한테 간다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 아들이 한 번만 더 읽어 달라고 계속 졸라서 결국 같은 책을 네 번이나 읽어 줬는데, 나중에는 애보다 내가 먼저 잠들고 있더라. 아마 애 방 바닥에서 몇 분 졸았던 것 같아. 깨 보니까 애가 내 얼굴을 콕콕 찌르고 있었거든.
sentences.text: My son kept asking for one more, so I ended up reading him the same book four times, and by the end I was falling asleep before he was. I'm pretty sure I dozed off on his floor for a few minutes, because I woke up and he was poking my face.

alts.text: My kid kept begging for one more, so I read him the same book four times, and by the end I was nodding off before he was. Pretty sure I passed out on his floor for a few minutes, since I woke up to him poking my face.

My son kept requesting one more reading, so I read him the same book four times, and by the end I was falling asleep before he did. I believe I dozed off on his floor for a few minutes, because when I awoke he was poking my face.

sentences.note: **dozed off** 는 깜빡 졸다, 잠깐 잠들다라는 뜻이에요. 캐주얼의 **nodding off** 도 고개를 꾸벅이며 조는 걸 말합니다.

reviewed: 1번 casual이 text와 앞부분이 거의 같아서(Tracking said out for delivery all day yesterday, so I stayed in and waited) 더 짧고 축약된 구어로 새로 씀. note의 flips to는 그대로 살림
4번 casual이 text와 앞부분이 겹쳐서(Whoever's upstairs is moving furniture around at two a.m., like every other night) 주어를 생략한 짧은 구어로 바꿈. note의 go straight to the landlord는 text에 그대로 있음
5번 formal이 text와 거의 같아서(continued to ask 말고는 그대로) 말투를 조금 더 올림. 뜻은 그대로 둠
